comment: The experimental-runtime lane's expected failures (#2256 U3, #2338), read by tools/expruntime-ratchet. First measured 2026-11-11 on epic/upstream-runtime by running `make test-experimental-ratchet`, not estimated. Every failure is a gap-table row: almost all are refusals by design (the toggle refuses a construct the new runtime cannot handle yet instead of planning it wrongly, so a test that uses it fails on the refusal); the rest name an accepted or loud-failing row, or the toggle's own warning. None is a marker, identity or record test. failures: tests that fail with TOFU_X_EXPERIMENTAL_RUNTIME=1. skips: fork-owned tests that call SkipExperimental. The list only shrinks: when a gap row closes, its tests pass and the ratchet requires taking them off.

Runs since the replacecycle fork port (#2380) turned ExperimentalBugStateCBD on, and fails on its last check: the new runtime records create_before_destroy in state, but on a plain create only the configured value, not one inherited from a create_before_destroy dependent. The inherited (effective) order is decided at plan time and is not carried into the execution graph; the next plan records it on the existing object. Waits for upstream (upstream #4714).
